statsd_host.description: IP address the StatsD daemon should listen on (e.g., '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces)

statsd_udp_port.description: UDP port to listen on for StatsD metrics (standard StatsD port)

statsd_tcp_port.description: TCP port to listen on for StatsD metrics; set to 0 to disable TCP support

statsd_metric_prefix.description: Prefix to prepend to all incoming StatsD metric names before storing them in Gnocchi (e.g., to namespace metrics)

statsd_udp_buffer_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of the UDP receive buffer; adjust for high-volume deployments

statsd_max_metrics_per_message.description: Maximum number of metrics to process per incoming message/packet (prevents oversized buffers)

statsd_flush_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) at which buffered metrics are flushed to Gnocchi; lower values reduce latency but increase overhead

statsd_create_metrics.description: Whether to automatically create new metrics in Gnocchi when they are first received

statsd_metrics.description: List of explicit metric definitions to map StatsD metric names to Gnocchi metric types and units; if empty, dynamic mapping is used

type.description: Gnocchi metric type the StatsD metric should be stored as

statsd_log_level.description: Logging verbosity for the StatsD daemon; 'debug' is recommended only for troubleshooting
